An already eligible detached contribution survives deletion of the originating account as private contributor association is removed. A Pending coffee does not contribute until actual canonical verification; earlier all-green shots can become eligible upon that transition without rewriting historical personal shot values/revisions.

per_line.source_text: Extreme time or ratio disagreements are held for member correction/confirmation, not automatically deleted or reclassified. The code first compares the member's prior all-green shots from the same coffee/setup/style (3 preceding observations). Otherwise it compares at least five **distinct other contributors** of the exact coffee/style, using medians; a heavily contributing single account cannot manufacture the comparison cohort. Ratios beyond 3× or below one-third, or times beyond 4× or below one-quarter, trigger **review rather than rejection**. These numerical thresholds are provisional code-level conservative heuristics, **not** new Locked style extraction windows, rigid eligibility exclusions, or scientific universal limits. Accepted user-confirmed unusual shots remain valid; confirmation is bound to the source-content fingerprint and cannot be reused after a substantive correction. Missing legitimate context is not fabricated.
